title: The Secret of Tremendous Corporation

expected_binary.basis: Pinned ScummVM 2026.3.0 SLUDGE detection table for The Secret of Tremendous Corporation v6

license_expectations: Current author metadata states LGPL-3.0 for code and CC-BY-SA-4.0 for assets
Pinned Steam-tag credits state that game code and original assets are CC-BY-SA-3.0 and separately enumerate third-party music, Freesound effects, voice work and a font
Third-party asset terms must be audited individually; current evidence includes noncommercial and Sampling+ material that prevents a blanket production approval
OpenSLUDGE licensing is separate from the game-data rights basis and must not be used to broaden rights in game assets
reason: The Steam release tag remains the correct source identity, but source review is intentionally open. The tagged in-game credits and Polish translation are explicit human-readable rights evidence, not merely fingerprints, because they distinguish original game material from separately licensed third-party assets. Audio fingerprints are retained to support later mapping between credited upstream works and files compiled into Version 6. No source audit result may be treated as production authorization until the third-party asset ledger is complete.
